lessons.title: Cheer for our team
lessons.en:
Ben: Anna, today is our Sports Day. Are you ready?
Anna: Yes! I'll run the 100-meter race.
Ben: Cool! I'll join the long jump.
Anna: Whether we win or lose, let's cheer for our team!
Ben: Right! Together we are strong.
lessons.cn:
本：安娜，今天是运动会，你准备好了吗？
安娜：好了！我跑 100 米。
本：酷！我参加跳远。
安娜：不管输赢，我们都为队加油！
本：对！团结就是力量。

lessons.title: A wonderful Sports Day
lessons.en: Today was our school's Sports Day. The playground was full of cheering students. I joined the relay race and helped my team win second place. Ben threw a small ball very far. Even when some friends lost, they smiled and tried again. Sports teach us teamwork and never giving up.
lessons.cn: 今天是学校运动会。操场上同学们都在加油。我参加接力赛，帮队伍拿到第二名。本扔小球扔得很远。即使有同学输了，他们也笑着再试。运动教会我们团队合作，永不放弃。
